description: This file defines the trait CalculatesChecksumTrait in the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for S3 operations. It provides a method for encoding checksum values using various algorithms, handling extension checks, and exceptions.

methods.name: getEncodedValue
methods.description: Generates an encoded checksum value based on the requested algorithm and input value, supporting CRC32C, CRC32, SHA256, and SHA1, with handling for missing extensions and invalid algorithms.
